changelog:
The phone's second opinion no longer condemns films it can play itself.

WHAT CHANGED

- When a cast fails, the phone re-checks the channel itself and tells you
  what it learned. That check knew the live-stream formats but not the
  containers films and episodes usually arrive in — so for a Matroska
  payload it said "the channel itself is the problem" while the phone
  could play it without issue. It now recognises Matroska/WebM and AVI,
  and its verdict can be trusted for films and series too.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. The check still asks the provider the same question
  the television asked, with the same details, and still errs toward
  "cannot tell" rather than blaming a channel on too little evidence.
